subject: RetailNova renewal: commit step-up, annual cadence, and ops sequencing
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@retailnova.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: RetailNova renewal: commit step-up, annual cadence, and ops sequencing

Hi Tom —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I’m sending a concise proposal for the renewal and the throughput uplift so your finance and procurement teams can review. High-level summary below, full SOW & pricing attached.

Key proposal (summary):
- Term: 12 months (annual prepay or monthly invoiced commit available; see pricing sheet)
- Commit: increase hosted API monthly commit to 3.5M tokens/month (from current 1.2M) with a burst pocket of 1.2M tokens per month for seasonal peaks
- Rate tiers: revised per-token pricing steps in attached pricing-summary.xlsx (volume bands at 3.5M+, 7M+, and 15M+ monthly)
- Soft-throttle: preserve soft-throttle graceband through 90% utilization to avoid production impact

Ops / onboarding notes (ops-onboarding-checklist.docx attached):
- Karthik will run a 2-week performance verification on a reserved pool (preferred) or dedicated burst nodes
- Vanessa will coordinate test traffic, KPIs, and latency SLOs during the ramp window

Next steps I suggest:
1) Confirm annual vs monthly billing preference and any prepay requirement
2) Procurement/Legal redline review of attached SOW (we can accept most customer redlines; Kimberly will review any non-standard clauses)
3) Sign DocuSign (link below) so we can schedule the provisioning window for Dec 6–10 (2-week verification then go-live)

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/some-doc-id-RETAILNOVA
HubSpot Deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345

Happy to jump on a quick call if useful.

Best,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
attachments: RetailNova_SOW_v3.pdf, pricing-summary.xlsx, ops-onboarding-checklist.docx
From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@retailnova.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@retailnova.com>, procurement@retailnova.com
Date: 2027-11-20T11:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RetailNova renewal: commit step-up, annual cadence, and ops sequencing

Hi Tessa —

Appreciate the clear summary. A few quick clarifications from our side before procurement takes the SOW:
- Finance: we prefer an annual prepay for budgeting reasons but need an option for quarterly invoicing; can you confirm pricing parity for annual prepay vs monthly invoiced commit?
- Ramp: our traffic profile ramps over roughly 6 months; can the committed units be phased (month 1 = 50% of new commit, month 2 = 70%, month 3+ = full)? We want to avoid paying for unused committed capacity in the early months.
- Security: procurement will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and confirmation that audit logs are retained for 13 months.

I’ve looped in Priya in procurement. Priya — can your team review the SOW and pricing; we can do a 30-minute call with Redwood legal if needed.

Thanks,
Tom
Director, Platform Engineering — RetailNova
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@retailnova.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@retailnova.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-20T13:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: RetailNova renewal: commit step-up, annual cadence, and ops sequencing

Tom — thanks. Quick answers inline below and next steps. Quoting your bullets: 

> Finance: we prefer an annual prepay for budgeting reasons but need an option for quarterly invoicing; can you confirm pricing parity for annual prepay vs monthly invoiced commit?

- Annual prepay gives a 6% discount vs monthly invoiced commit in the attached pricing summary. Quarterly invoicing is possible (no discount) — I noted both options in the SOW.

> Ramp: our traffic profile ramps over roughly 6 months; can the committed units be phased (month 1 = 50% of new commit, month 2 = 70%, month 3+ = full)?

- Yes — we can map a phased commit ladder in the SOW. Our proposed phased schedule: Month 1 = 50%, Month 2 = 75%, Month 3 = 100% (Month 4+ full sustain). If you need a 6-month ramp we can extend the ladder to smaller increments; Karthik put together an ops sequence (attached) that outlines verification gates and cost proration for partial months.

> Security: procurement will need SOC 2 Type II evidence and confirmation that audit logs are retained for 13 months.

- We are SOC 2 Type II certified; I attached the SOC 2 attestation stub link in the drive doc (https://drive.redwood.com/retailnova/compliance). Audit logs retention: default retention is 12 months, but for enterprise Private/Dedicated customers we support 13–24 month retention via our compliance add-on. Kimberly, from Legal, is cc’d for any contract language around retention.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Priya / Procurement to redline SOW and upload to DocuSign for signature by 11/24 to meet provisioning timeline
- Vanessa to schedule a 45-minute kickoff with your engineering team for Tuesday 11/30 (Karthik will be on the call to outline test plan)

I’ll also open a provisional provisioning slot Dec 6–10 pending signature.

—Tessa

Date: 2027-11-21T10:35:00-08:00
Subject: RE: RetailNova renewal: commit step-up, annual cadence, and ops sequencing

Tessa / Tom —

Thanks for the proposal. A few procurement items to flag from our side after an initial read: 
1) Contract term: RetailNova prefers a 12-month term but requires a 30-day exit clause tied to performance SLAs in the first 90 days. We’ll propose language that triggers the exit option only if Redwood misses the latency SLOs in two consecutive weeks.
2) Ramp/proration: We will accept a phased commit ladder, but require that billing reflect actual usage vs committed units during ramp months (i.e., prorated charge for partial commit).
3) Compliance evidence: please share the SOC 2 Type II PDF and the retention addendum text to include in the SOW. We also need the contact for your security reviewer for an evidence-pack exchange by 11/25.

Attached I’ll upload a redline doc to DocuSign later today. If Redwood legal can pre-review the redlines, let’s schedule a 30-minute call on 11/22 at 09:00 PT.

Best,
Priya Shah
Senior Procurement Manager — RetailNova
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@retailnova.com>, Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@retailnova.com>

Subject: Re: RetailNova renewal: commit step-up, annual cadence, and ops sequencing — attachments and scheduling

Priya / Tom —

Thanks — attached is the updated SOW (RetailNova_SOW_v3.pdf) with the phased-ladder language and a sample 30-day exit clause tied to the two-week SLA misses. I’ve also attached the pricing summary and the ops checklist.

Compliance pack & security contact:
- SOC 2 Type II PDF: https://drive.redwood.com/retailnova/compliance/soc2-type2-2027.pdf
- Retention addendum language is included in Section 5.4 of the SOW (we support 13 months as requested)
- Security contact: Anika Bose (anika.bose@redwood.com) — she can run an evidence exchange and will be on the 11/25 call if helpful.

Call options:
- Redwood legal (Kimberly) is available for a 30-minute call on 11/22 at 09:00 PT (as requested) — Kimberly will review procurement redlines and discuss the exit-clause wording.
- Vanessa will send the Ops kickoff invite for 11/30 (45 minutes) with Karthik and your engineering leads.

If everything looks good after the redline, I’ll send the DocuSign for signature and we’ll lock the provisioning window Dec 6–10.

Thanks again — looking forward to getting RetailNova scheduled.

Best,
Tessa
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
